basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast based in Milan, Italy. I enjoy building custom PCs and am always on the lookout for the latest gaming peripherals. I work as a network engineer, which sometimes leads to long hours, but I always make time for a quick gaming session. Not a fan of poorly optimized games and unreliable internet connections. Typically online in the evenings and weekends. Currently in a long-term relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from a local university and over a decade of experience in the IT industry, this user has a strong grasp of network infrastructure. They stay updated through tech forums, self-study, and hands-on experience with tech projects.
